doc.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12

title: Dr. Oster's return visit and spiritual numbers
summary: They discuss when Dr. Oster at LSU might come back, wanting a Sunday visit, and the spiritual numbers they have for him.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: I'll probably be back again with Dr. Oster. I've been here before, wasn't I? I'm sorry. I'm sorry. We're not a bad man. Tell me where's Dr. Oster now? At LSU. In Baton Rouge. He was supposed to be gone in Pennsylvania State. He left me. No, he's still there. I talked to him yesterday on the phone. I talked to him again today, I hope. When I go to Baton Rouge. Because I had some good numbers for him. You couldn't make it on Sunday. Well, I think he can make it on Sunday. You want me to tell him that you can see it on Sunday? Yes, but they're all spiritual numbers. Yeah, because I've seen the wine bottles sitting on the other end. Who's that talking to you? I think he's still there. I talked to him yesterday on the phone. I talked to him again today, I hope. When I go to Baton Rouge. Because I had some good numbers for him, man. If you were coming back, it would have to be on a Sunday afternoon, man. You couldn't make it on Sunday. I think he can make it on Sunday. You want me to tell him that you can see it on Sunday? Yes, but they're all spiritual numbers, man. Yeah, because I've seen the wine bottles sitting on the other end. Who's that talking to you? That's a boy, not a boy. That's Carl. I've seen him out. Come across the levee too.
